subject.title: feat(ui): collapse completed turn work behind a "Worked for X" rollup

question: Should normal completed turns collapse by default while `/verbose full` continues to keep the complete transcript expanded?
rationale: This feature deliberately changes transcript visibility, and the protected `maintainer` label leaves the permanent verbose-mode contract to human product ownership.

options.title: Preserve verbose-full
options.body: Collapse completed turns for normal verbosity but default the turn disclosure open when `autoExpandToolCalls` is active.

options.title: Redefine verbose-full
options.body: Collapse completed turns in every mode and accept that full verbosity no longer means immediately visible completed work.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the rollup until maintainers settle the completed-turn visibility contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve verbose-full
recommendation.body: Collapse completed turns for normal verbosity but default the turn disclosure open when `autoExpandToolCalls` is active.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature direction and initial implementation originate with this contributor, providing the strongest available routing signal for the product choice.
